description: Fetch the valid codes and labels for one dimension of a dataflow, including each code's parent ID in hierarchical codelists. Use to resolve human-readable names (countries, measures) to SDMX codes before querying with oecd_query_dataset. Pass parent to list direct children of one parent code, or query to match a code or label by substring — codelists run to a thousand-plus entries, and the response is a page of at most limit codes either way. A codelist is shared across dataflows and can list codes this one holds no data for: pass available_only to list only the codes with data, or key to list the codes with data given the key's other segments — a structure read, never a data download.

available_only.description: List only the codes of this dimension that have data in this dataflow, from OECD's availability record, with the time_range and observation_count they cover. Applied before parent, query, offset, and limit. Default false: the whole codelist.

dimension_id.description: Dimension identifier to fetch codes for — e.g. "REF_AREA" or "MEASURE". Obtain valid dimension IDs from oecd_get_dataset_info.

end_period.description: Inclusive upper SDMX period bound, e.g. "2024" or "2024-Q4". A nonblank value implies available_only.

flow_ref.description: Full flow reference — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAAG@DF_NAAG_I", or the bare "OECD.TAD.ARP,DF_AEI2024_DASHBOARD" form for a dataflow published without a datastructure prefix. Obtain from oecd_search_datasets.

key.description: Dot-delimited key in the oecd_query_dataset form, one segment per dimension in the order oecd_get_dataset_info gives — empty for a wildcard, "+" between codes, or "all". Lists the codes of this dimension that have data given the key's other segments, so pass the key you plan to query. Implies available_only.

limit.description: Maximum codes to return. Default 50; a larger value returns at most 10,000 and says so.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first code to return within the matching list, applied before limit. Advance it to page; an offset past the last match returns an empty page.

parent.description: Filter to codes whose parent code equals this value (exact case-sensitive code match, e.g. "FRA" for France's TL2 regions). Applied after available_only and key, and before query, offset, and limit. Omit to include codes at all hierarchy levels.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against both the code and its label, so "PA" and "percent" each reach the code "PA" / "Percent per annum". Applied after available_only, key, and parent. Omit to page the full matching list.

start_period.description: Inclusive lower SDMX period bound, e.g. "2024" or "2024-Q1". A nonblank value implies available_only.

version.description: Published dataflow edition, for example 1.1. Omit to use the latest edition.

name: oecd_get_dimension_values

available_only.description: True when codes holds only the codes with data, as OECD records them. False for the whole codelist, including when availability was asked for and could not be read — the notice then says why.

code_count.description: Number of codes in this page — not the size of the dimension's codelist.

codes.description: The requested page of codes, after available_only, parent, query, offset, and limit are applied.

items.description: A valid SDMX code, its human-readable label, and its parent code when hierarchical.

id.description: SDMX code — use in the dimension key for oecd_query_dataset.

name.description: Human-readable label for the code — the code itself for a code with data that the codelist does not list.

parent.description: Parent code ID in hierarchical codelists; absent for top-level codes.

dimension_id.description: The dimension whose codes are listed.

effectiveQuery.description: The substring filter as applied. Absent when the whole codelist was paged.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_flow_ref`: The flow_ref parameter matches neither the {agencyID},{dsd_id}@{df_id} nor the {agencyID},{df_id} format. `dataflow_not_found`: The flow_ref does not correspond to a known dataflow. `dimension_not_found`: The dimension_id names no dimension of this dataflow's key — its time dimension included, which has no codelist. `codelist_not_found`: OECD does not serve the codelist revision referenced by an explicitly selected edition. `invalid_key`: The key holds a character outside the SDMX key set, fewer dot-delimited segments than the dataflow has dimensions, or a non-empty segment past the dimension count. `invalid_period`: A period bound is an impossible calendar date or start_period is after end_period. `rate_limited`: OECD throttled the request rate and was still refusing after the retries, or asked for a wait longer than the call's upstream budget had left. `upstream_timeout`: An OECD request ran past OECD_TIMEOUT_MS, or the call's requests and retries together ran past its upstream budget — 50 seconds, or OECD_TIMEOUT_MS when that is longer. `upstream_unavailable`: OECD returned a server fault or was unreachable once the retries ran out. `upstream_redirect`: The configured OECD host answered with a redirect, which this server never follows. `upstream_error`: OECD refused the request with a status this server does not model — an authorization challenge, a rejection from something sitting in front of the API, a request read as malformed or unprocessable (HTTP 400 or 422), or a method it does not implement (HTTP 501). `upstream_unreadable`: OECD answered with a body this server could not read — not JSON, or JSON whose fields do not have the shape SDMX gives them — or a datastructure naming a codelist outside the SDMX character set. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

flow_ref.description: The flow reference this dimension belongs to.

notice.description: Present when the page needs explaining — a limit above the per-call maximum, availability that could not be read, a key that matches no series or pins a code that matches only by letter case, a dimension with no codelist, a parent filter or query that matched nothing, or codes beyond the page. One string when several apply; states how to reach the rest.

observation_count.description: Observations under the key and applied period bounds, as OECD counts them. Present when available_only applied and OECD reported a count.

query_end_period.description: Requested upper period bound, present when applied to availability.

query_start_period.description: Requested lower period bound, present when applied to availability.

time_range.description: Time range reported by OECD, when available. Can describe source coverage beyond the applied period bounds.

end.description: Last day of OECD’s reported coverage, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

start.description: First day of OECD’s reported coverage, YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive.

totalCount.description: Codes matching after available_only, parent, and query — before offset and limit — disclosed when the page does not cover them all.

title: Oecd Get Dimension Values
